summary.ko: 해외 보도는 대체로 긍정적이며, 인도의 $500 million 신용한도 확대와 도미니카공화국과의 새로운 에너지 협력이 주를 이룹니다. 국내 언론은 긴장 상황을 보도하고 있습니다. 경찰 구금 중 사망 사건, 9주째 이어지는 시위, 야당 탄압을 둘러싼 논쟁이 이어지며 점수는 중간 수준에 머물러 있습니다.
summary.hi: विदेशी कवरेज मुख्यतः सकारात्मक है, जिसमें भारत द्वारा $500 million की ऋण सीमा विस्तार और डोमिनिकन गणराज्य के साथ नए ऊर्जा सहयोग प्रमुख हैं। घरेलू मीडिया में तनाव की रिपोर्टें हैं: पुलिस हिरासत में मौत, नौवें सप्ताह में प्रवेश कर चुके विरोध प्रदर्शन और विपक्ष के उत्पीड़न पर विवाद, जिनके कारण स्कोर मध्य के आसपास बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η ξένη κάλυψη είναι σε μεγάλο βαθμό θετική, με επικεφαλής την επέκταση πιστωτικής γραμμής $500 million από την Ινδία και τη νέα ενεργειακή συνεργασία με τη Δομινικανή Δημοκρατία. Τα εγχώρια μέσα ενημέρωσης αναφέρουν πιέσεις: θάνατο σε αστυνομική κράτηση, διαμαρτυρίες που βρίσκονται στην ένατη εβδομάδα τους και διαφωνίες για τη δίωξη της αντιπολίτευσης, που κρατούν τη βαθμολογία κοντά στο μέσο.
summary.tr: Yabancı haberler büyük ölçüde olumlu olup Hindistan'ın 500 milyon dolarlık kredi hattı genişletmesi ve Dominik Cumhuriyeti ile yeni enerji iş birliği öne çıkıyor. Yurt içi medyada gerginlik yansıyor: polis gözetiminde bir ölüm, dokuzuncu haftasına giren protestolar ve muhalefet zulmü iddialarına ilişkin tartışmalar, puanı orta seviyeye yakın tutuyor.
summary.es: La cobertura extranjera es mayoritariamente positiva, encabezada por la ampliación de la línea de crédito de India por 500 millones de dólares y la nueva cooperación energética con la República Dominicana. Los medios nacionales reflejan tensión: una muerte bajo custodia policial, protestas que llegan a su novena semana y disputas sobre la persecución a la oposición, lo que mantiene la puntuación cerca del punto medio.
summary.fr: La couverture étrangère est largement positive, portée par l'extension de 500 millions de dollars de la ligne de crédit accordée par l'Inde et par une nouvelle coopération énergétique avec la République dominicaine. Les médias nationaux font état de tensions : un décès en garde à vue, des manifestations en leur neuvième semaine et des litiges sur la persécution de l'opposition, ce qui maintient le score près du milieu de l'échelle.
summary.de: Die Auslandsberichterstattung ist überwiegend positiv, angeführt von der Erweiterung der indischen Kreditlinie um 500 Millionen US-Dollar und einer neuen Energiekooperation mit der Dominikanischen Republik. Inlandsmedien berichten über Spannungen: ein Todesfall in Polizeigewahrsam, Proteste in der neunten Woche und Streit über die Verfolgung der Opposition, weshalb der Wert nahe der Mitte bleibt.
summary.pt: A cobertura estrangeira é em grande parte positiva, liderada pela extensão de US$ 500 milhões da linha de crédito da Índia e pela nova cooperação energética com a República Dominicana. A mídia doméstica relata tensões: uma morte sob custódia policial, protestos na nona semana e disputas sobre a perseguição à oposição, o que mantém a pontuação perto do meio.

en: India announces $500 million credit line extension and infrastructure agreements
Death in police custody and police brutality allegations draw party condemnation
MV Barima families' protests continue into ninth week

summary.en: There is no clear crisis in Romania in the past 24 hours. A parliamentary confidence vote will be held for the new Niculescu government, signaling a political transition. A low-risk earthquake (M4.8) and security developments, such as Romanian F-16s shooting down two UAVs over the Black Sea, are balanced by a food poisoning incident after a wedding. It was assessed as an ordinary period.

en: Parliamentary confidence vote for the Niculescu government
Romanian F-16s shot down two UAVs over the Black Sea (regional security risk)
M4.8 earthquake, no serious damage reported
Fuel prices fell, with petrol under 10 lei at some stations
Food poisoning of more than 20 people after a wedding at the Brukenthal Palace

summary.en: Parliament approved a new minority government, ending a roughly six-month political crisis, which is a clear stabilising development. This is offset by heightened security concerns, with drone incursions near the Tulcea border, Ro-Alert alerts and NATO reinforcements in the Black Sea region.

en: New government won confidence vote, ending months-long political crisis
Drone incursions and Ro-Alert alerts in Tulcea raise border security concerns
NATO increases Black Sea deployment and troops in Romania and Bulgaria

summary.en: The government crisis ended with Luca Niculescu's new cabinet sworn in and winning confidence, a step toward institutional stability. Security concerns persist after drone debris was found near Sulina, and fiscal and legal issues remain, so the day is broadly ordinary with a slight positive tilt.

en: New government sworn in and won confidence vote, ending the political crisis
Drone debris found in Buzău county; CSAT security meeting held
Fiscal consolidation priority and SAFE motorway contract irregularities reported

summary.en: The day was dominated by violent attacks at schools in Pitești and Bistrița, which prompted an emergency government meeting, and by Russian drone incursions over the Black Sea. A new government formed after a months-long political crisis is a stabilising counterpoint, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Violent attacks at schools in Pitești and Bistrița; government emergency meeting
Romania shot down five Russian drones; Black Sea shipping attacks
New government formed, ending prolonged political crisis

summary.en: Romania's period was dominated by a drone strike that sank a cargo ship off its Black Sea coast, killing one and leaving three missing, with Romania blaming Russia and seeking NATO defence support amid a wider run of ship attacks. Domestic news was otherwise routine (fog, weather, winter prices, a handball win), so the score sits in the serious-concern range rather than lower.

en: Drone strike sinks cargo ship off Romanian coast; one dead, three missing
Romania blames Russia and requests NATO defensive support
Eight ships attacked in 18 days raises Black Sea security concerns

summary.en: The period mixes routine news (Army Day ceremonies, fog warnings, a new government reported after six months of crisis) with serious negatives: a drone strike that sank a cargo ship near Constanța, leaving one dead and three missing, plus a Bucharest building evacuation and a troubled Cernavoda nuclear plant. The drone attack and its casualties outweigh the positive political news, so the score sits below a typical day.

en: Drone strike sinks cargo ship off Constanța; one dead, three missing
Romania blames Russia for the drone attack
New government reported after six months of political crisis

summary.en: The period looks like routine political churn: a government transition to a new cabinet, a court hearing on extending pre-trial detention for Călin Georgescu, and softer demand for state bonds. GDELT tone (-0.12) is milder than the world average, and there is no sign of unrest or institutional breakdown, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day for fiscal strain.

en: Government change to Niculescu cabinet and debt-financing strain
Court hearing on extending Georgescu's pre-trial detention
Weaker appetite for state bonds, per Cotidianul

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several concerns: Romanian intelligence exposed a Russia-linked sabotage network tied to a fire near a weapons factory, and a water crisis in Prahova is affecting a dam. Institutions appear to be functioning, with courts hearing the coup-attempt case and intelligence publicly attributing the sabotage, and the earthquakes and tax-uncertainty stories appear to involve no major casualties.

en: Russia-linked sabotage network near weapons factory uncovered by intelligence
Prahova water crisis and Paltinu dam repair delays
Two Vrancea earthquakes in under four hours, no casualties reported

summary.en: Romania's period is dominated by a Russian-linked sabotage plot (the Carfil arms factory fire, two arrests in Germany, an ambassador summoned) and a cyber alert that caused public alarm, plus Black Sea shipping attacks that prompted French patrol support. Some mild positives appear, such as a forecast of falling inflation, but security pressure outweighs them.

en: Alleged Russian sabotage network behind Carfil arms factory fire
Romania summons Russian ambassador; NATO patrol support in Black Sea
Cyber alert notifying 17,500 public institutions, causing public panic

summary.en: The day is dominated by Black Sea security concerns: drone attacks, a suspected Russian sabotage plot, and reports that the country's only nuclear plant has not fully resumed operation. Domestic politics and economy coverage is otherwise routine, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Suspected Russian sabotage plot and drone attacks in the Black Sea
Only nuclear plant not yet back in operation after cooling problems
Ongoing political feud over the European Prosecutor's mandate

summary.en: The period looks routine, with a new government formed, a hospital opened, energy and defence deals, and the Colectiv fire anniversary commemorated rather than a new crisis. Negative items include polling gains for opposition parties and a diplomatic spat with Bulgaria, and GDELT tone is close to the world average.

en: New government formed, per Jamestown report
Mazarine Energy deal to buy BSOG; defence contracts with Thales
Colectiv fire 11-year commemoration; ongoing compensation and burn-centre debate

summary.en: The period looks like a routine news day, with positive items (a US official praising Romania's NATO role, SOCAR's 100th station, tourism promotion) balanced against security and social stress (Romania's sabotage accusations against Russia, violence against women, public anger over health contributions). Nothing points to a clear crisis or a clear breakthrough.

en: Romania accuses Russia of Brașov sabotage and Black Sea ship attacks
US official praises Romania's role in NATO
Public anger over health contributions and violence against women coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: severe weather warnings, a few minor earthquakes, road accidents and a drone incursion that prompted fighter scrambles without reported damage. A positive gas-sector project announcement roughly offsets these security and disruption stories, so the day sits near a typical one.

en: Drone incursion over eastern Romania prompted fighter jets and airspace closures
Severe weather warnings for heavy rain, snow and wind
Four consecutive earthquakes reported overnight

summary.en: Romania's period mixes a positive defence step, a historic joint military acquisition with Moldova under the SAFE mechanism, with security tension from massive drone attacks on Ukrainian Danube ports that prompted RO-Alert and F-16 scrambles. Storm warnings and complaints about bank lending add mild strain, but no harm or institutional crisis is reported.

en: Historic Romania–Moldova defence agreement and first joint SAFE military purchase
Massive drone attacks near Tulcea prompted RO-Alert and F-16 scrambles
Orange storm warnings and cyclone-driven weather across several counties

summary.en: Romania's day mixes positive signals, including a successful €8.5 billion external bond placement after the political crisis and a defence procurement deal with Moldova, with security strain from drone incidents and Black Sea attacks. Weather warnings and heating and energy-cost problems add to the mostly routine picture, and the news tone is less negative than the world average.

en: €8.5bn external bond demand after political crisis
Romania-Moldova joint military procurement agreement under SAFE
Drone incursions and Black Sea attacks raising escalation concerns

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: a minor 3.5-magnitude Vrancea earthquake, a rail embankment collapse, and weather warnings, offset by positive rail modernisation (Alstom ETCS Level 2 launch) and corporate deals. Drone incidents near NATO airspace and a new government add some tension, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Alstom ETCS Level 2 passenger service launched, a positive infrastructure step
Minor 3.5-magnitude earthquake in Vrancea with no reported damage
Rail embankment collapse blocks traffic toward Mangalia

summary.en: The day's coverage is mixed and mostly routine: a legal process around Călin Georgescu, debate over US troops and fiscal consolidation, and market volatility. Negative items include Black Sea ship incidents and a tugboat distress call, partly offset by the Cernavoda reactor restart and a new motorway section opening, and the GDELT tone is clearly more negative than the world average.
summary.tr: Günün haberleri karışık ve çoğunlukla rutin nitelikte: Călin Georgescu etrafında yürütülen bir hukuki süreç, ABD birlikleri ve mali konsolidasyon üzerine tartışma ile piyasa oynaklığı. Olumsuz haberler arasında Karadeniz'deki gemi olayları ve bir römorkörün tehlike çağrısı yer alıyor; bunları kısmen Cernavoda reaktörünün yeniden çalıştırılması ve yeni bir otoyol bölümünün açılması dengeliyor. GDELT tonu ise dünya ortalamasından belirgin biçimde daha olumsuz.
summary.es: La cobertura del día es mixta y en su mayoría rutinaria: un proceso judicial en torno a Călin Georgescu, el debate sobre las tropas estadounidenses y la consolidación fiscal, y la volatilidad de los mercados. Entre los asuntos negativos figuran los incidentes con buques en el mar Negro y una llamada de socorro de un remolcador, compensados en parte por la reanudación del reactor de Cernavoda y la apertura de un nuevo tramo de autopista; el tono de GDELT es claramente más negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La couverture de la journée est mitigée et principalement routinière : une procédure judiciaire impliquant Călin Georgescu, le débat sur les troupes américaines et la consolidation budgétaire, ainsi que la volatilité des marchés. Les éléments négatifs comprennent des incidents impliquant des navires en mer Noire et un appel de détresse d'un remorqueur, partiellement compensés par le redémarrage du réacteur de Cernavoda et l'ouverture d'un nouveau tronçon d'autoroute ; le ton GDELT est nettement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung des Tages ist gemischt und überwiegend routinemäßig: ein Rechtsverfahren um Călin Georgescu, die Debatte über US-Truppen und Haushaltskonsolidierung sowie Marktvolatilität. Zu den negativen Meldungen gehören Schiffszwischenfälle im Schwarzen Meer und ein Notruf eines Schleppers, teilweise ausgeglichen durch den Wiederanlauf des Reaktors Cernavoda und die Eröffnung eines neuen Autobahnabschnitts; der GDELT-Ton ist deutlich negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: A cobertura do dia é mista e, em grande parte, rotineira: um processo jurídico envolvendo Călin Georgescu, o debate sobre tropas dos EUA e a consolidação fiscal, além da volatilidade dos mercados. Entre os itens negativos estão incidentes com navios no Mar Negro e um pedido de socorro de um rebocador, parcialmente compensados pelo reinício do reator de Cernavoda e pela abertura de um novo trecho de rodovia; o tom do GDELT é claramente mais negativo que a média mundial.
summary.ja: 本日の報道は、概ね日常的で評価が分かれている。Călin Georgescuを巡る法的手続き、米軍駐留と財政再建に関する議論、市場の変動が主な内容である。否定的な報道には黒海での船舶事故やタグボートの遭難信号が含まれ、一部はCernavoda原子炉の再稼働と新しい高速道路区間の開通によって相殺されている。GDELTのトーンは世界平均と比べて明らかに否定的である。
summary.ko: 오늘의 보도는 대체로 일상적이며 엇갈린 내용을 담고 있다. Călin Georgescu 관련 법적 절차, 미군 주둔과 재정 건전화를 둘러싼 논쟁, 시장 변동성이 주요 내용이다. 부정적인 소식으로는 흑해 선박 사고와 예인선 조난 신호가 있으며, Cernavoda 원자로 재가동과 신규 고속도로 구간 개통이 이를 일부 상쇄한다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 뚜렷이 부정적이다.
summary.hi: आज की कवरेज मिश्रित और ज़्यादातर नियमित है: Călin Georgescu से जुड़ी कानूनी प्रक्रिया, अमेरिकी सैनिकों और राजकोषीय समेकन पर बहस, तथा बाज़ार की अस्थिरता। नकारात्मक खबरों में काला सागर में जहाज़ों की घटनाएँ और एक टग बोट का संकट संकेत शामिल हैं, जिन्हें आंशिक रूप से Cernavoda रिएक्टर के दोबारा चालू होने और एक नए मोटरवे खंड के खुलने से संतुलित किया गया है। GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से स्पष्ट रूप से अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η σημερινή κάλυψη είναι μικτή και κυρίως συνηθισμένη: μια νομική διαδικασία γύρω από τον Călin Georgescu, η συζήτηση για τα αμερικανικά στρατεύματα και τη δημοσιονομική εξυγίανση, και η αστάθεια των αγορών. Τα αρνητικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν περιστατικά με πλοία στη Μαύρη Θάλασσα και έναν σήμα κινδύνου ρυμουλκού, εν μέρει αντισταθμισμένα από την επανεκκίνηση του αντιδραστήρα του Cernavoda και το άνοιγμα ενός νέου τμήματος αυτοκινητοδρόμου. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι σαφώς πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: La copertura della giornata è mista e per lo più di routine: un procedimento giudiziario riguardante Călin Georgescu, il dibattito sulle truppe statunitensi e sul consolidamento fiscale, e la volatilità dei mercati. Tra gli elementi negativi figurano episodi di navi nel Mar Nero e una richiesta di soccorso di un rimorchiatore, in parte compensati dalla riattivazione del reattore di Cernavoda e dall'apertura di un nuovo tratto autostradale; il tono di GDELT è chiaramente più negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Освещение за день неоднозначное и в основном рутинное: судебный процесс, связанный с Калином Георгеску, дискуссия о присутствии американских военных и фискальной консолидации, а также волатильность рынков. Негативные события включают инциденты с судами в Черном море и сигнал бедствия буксира, частично компенсируемые перезапуском реактора в Чернаводэ и открытием нового участка автомагистрали; тон GDELT заметно более негативный, чем в среднем по миру.
summary.ar: تغطية اليوم متباينة وروتينية في معظمها: إجراء قانوني يتعلق بكالين جورجيسكو، ونقاش حول القوات الأمريكية وتقليص العجز المالي، وتقلبات في الأسواق. تشمل العناصر السلبية حوادث استهداف السفن في البحر الأسود ونداء استغاثة من قاطرة، ويخفف من ذلك جزئيا إعادة تشغيل مفاعل تشيرنافودا وافتتاح مقطع جديد من الطريق السريع؛ ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية بوضوح من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری امروز متفاوت و عمدتاً روتین است: یک روند قضایی درباره کالین جورجسکو، بحث درباره نیروهای آمریکایی و تثبیت مالی، و نوسانات بازار. موارد منفی شامل حوادث کشتی‌ها در دریای سیاه و تماس اضطراری یک یدک‌کش است که تا حدی با راه‌اندازی مجدد راکتور چرناوودا و افتتاح بخشی جدید از بزرگراه جبران می‌شود؛ لحن GDELT به‌وضوح منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 当日报道喜忧参半，大多属于常规新闻：围绕卡林·乔治斯库的法律程序、关于美国驻军和财政整顿的争论，以及市场波动。负面消息包括黑海船只事件和一艘拖船的求救信号，部分被切尔纳沃达核反应堆重启和一段新高速公路通车所抵消；GDELT的语气明显比世界平均水平更为负面。

summary.en: The disappearance of four Salvadoran air force members after a gang ambush in Haiti is the main negative development of the period. Otherwise, routine news continues: port traffic, budget and investment stories, and heavy sentences handed to gang members. A survey showing economic hardship and uncertainty over TPS add further pressure, but no serious crisis is evident within the country.

en: Disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti after an ambush, with claims that a gang took them hostage
Economic hardship revealed by the survey and uncertainty over TPS (Temporary Protected Status)
Doubling of container traffic at the Acajutla port, along with border modernization and investment funds
Bukele's security criticisms directed at international organizations and heavy prison sentences for gang members

summary.en: Mostly routine news: positive security polling and court convictions of gang members sit alongside a serious incident in which four Salvadoran soldiers went missing after a gang ambush in Haiti. A swarm of earthquakes in Usulután and an Ebola-related travel restriction add to the strain, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after gang ambush in Haiti
UN demands release of kidnapped Salvadoran soldiers
Dozens of earthquakes swarm Usulután within hours

summary.en: Four Salvadoran soldiers were kidnapped by gangs in Haiti, and the government launched a military rescue operation while threatening retaliation, dominating coverage. Domestic routine items (a tax amnesty, trade funding, an extended security regime, an insurer rating) are modest offsets, and the news tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers held hostage by gangs in Haiti
Military rescue operation launched in Haiti; Bukele threatens reprisals
Security state-of-exception extended; tax amnesty and trade funds approved

summary.en: The period is dominated by the kidnapping of four Salvadoran soldiers by gangs in Haiti and a special-forces rescue mission, with heavy international coverage and tense rhetoric from the president. This is a serious security episode, partly offset by ECLAC raising its growth forecast to 4.5% and otherwise routine domestic news.

en: Four soldiers kidnapped in Haiti; special forces deployed for rescue
Presidential threats toward Haitian gangs dominate foreign coverage
ECLAC raises El Salvador growth forecast to 4.5%

summary.en: The period is dominated by a foreign-facing crisis: four Salvadoran soldiers reportedly captured or missing after an ambush in Haiti, with special forces deployed to find them. Domestically the news is mostly routine, though rising food prices and a large gang prosecution add some strain.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing or held by gangs in Haiti
Special forces and about 200 troops deployed to Haiti for rescue
Basic food basket at its highest price of 2026

summary.en: The period is dominated by the fallout from an ambush of Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, with four soldiers still missing and bodies found that the president says are not theirs, plus a UN condemnation. Domestic routine stories, a reported pension payment stoppage and a push for life sentences for Barrio 18 leaders add to a tense but not crisis-level picture.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing after ambush in Haiti
UN condemns attack on Salvadoran military in Haiti
Reported pension payments stopped in October

summary.en: The period mixes routine local crime and traffic news with a tense, unresolved story over four missing Salvadoran soldiers in Haiti, where remains were found but not confirmed. Moody's saying a pension deal eases fiscal pressure and a 10-hour power-cut notice are the main other developments, so the picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Remains found in Haiti; identity of missing soldiers unconfirmed
Moody's: pension deal eases El Salvador fiscal pressure
10-hour power outages announced for several zones

summary.en: Foreign media report NGO allegations of hundreds of prison deaths under the state of emergency and roughly 93,000 people jailed without warrants, alongside reports of soldiers kidnapped in Haiti. Positive items (housing and road funding, a port export push, an election campaign opening) are routine and do not offset the human-rights crisis.

en: NGO allegations of hundreds of prison deaths under emergency rule
Mass detentions without warrants reported (about 93,000 people)
Soldiers reportedly kidnapped in Haiti during deployment

summary.en: Domestic news is routine, with high reported approval, budget and social-program items, and a minor drowning. The period is dominated by a serious security crisis: about 1,000 troops deployed to Haiti after a gang ambush, with four soldiers missing and a gang leader claiming they are dead.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers missing in Haiti after gang ambush
Around 1,000 troops deployed to Haiti as reinforcement
Bukele disputes that found bodies belong to missing soldiers

summary.en: The period mixes routine judicial and legislative news, such as housing-credit approvals and Saca's release, with a serious security incident: an ambush in Haiti left four Salvadoran soldiers missing and prompted a large troop deployment. Foreign coverage also reports postponed elections and criticism of Bukele's governance, which weighs the score below an ordinary day.

en: Ambush in Haiti leaves four Salvadoran soldiers missing
Over 2,000 troops deployed to Haiti for rescue
Reported postponement of elections in foreign coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: court convictions, extraditions and tax agreements, alongside a military operation in Haiti and the release of ex-president Saca after a 10-year sentence. Domestic news shows no acute crisis, and the negative GDELT tone is only a secondary signal.

en: Deployment of about 2,000 soldiers and rescue operation in Haiti
Ex-president Saca released after serving 10-year corruption sentence
Tax agreements with Türkiye and UAE to avoid double taxation

summary.en: Routine-to-mildly-positive day: foreign-policy activity dominated by a Haiti troop deployment with reported US backing, plus gang convictions, trade outreach and a new international conference centre groundbreaking. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines describe no domestic crisis.

en: Troop deployment to Haiti with reported US backing
Mass convictions of gang members with long prison terms
Groundbreaking of Chinese-backed international conference centre

summary.en: The period was dominated by a contested foreign deployment: Salvadoran troops began street patrols in Haiti after four soldiers went missing, and allegations of civilian bombings were denied by Bukele. Domestic news was mostly routine, with gang arrests and a fuel price rise, and tone was more negative than the world average.

en: Salvadoran troops' Haiti deployment, four soldiers missing, civilian bombing allegations denied
Families demanding fair trials and mourning prison deaths

summary.en: The period is mostly routine cultural and local news, but it is dominated by a Salvadoran military operation in Haiti, with four soldiers reported missing, allegations of civilian bombings that the government denies, and reports of a major offensive against gangs. The Honduras extradition and the domestic festivals are minor positives, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Salvadoran troops' offensive in Haiti with civilian harm allegations denied
Four soldiers reported missing during the Haiti operation
Honduras extradition of a wanted suspect to El Salvador

summary.en: Coverage is dominated by the deployment of about 2,000 Salvadoran troops to Haiti, where gang clashes are intensifying and four Salvadorans have been missing for 15 days. Domestic news is otherwise routine (Day of the Dead, arrests, a traffic death), so the period is only mildly negative.

en: Salvadoran troop deployment to Haiti amid intensifying gang clashes
Four Salvadorans reported missing in Haiti for 15 days

summary.en: El Salvador's main story is its military offensive against gangs in Haiti, which drew international concern over the deployment, a UN statement on the force, and a gang leader's claims about missing Salvadorans. Domestic news is otherwise routine, with a positive IMF visit conclusion and a US meeting, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Salvadoran troops launch offensive against gangs in Haiti
UN says most Salvadoran soldiers not in gang suppression force

summary.en: The period is dominated by the military deployment to Haiti, including an ambush, reports of Salvadoran soldiers killed or missing, and a burned vehicle, which weighs negatively. Domestic news is routine, with ratified tax agreements with Türkiye and the UAE, a Cambridge early-childhood partnership and tourism coverage offsetting it.
summary.ja: 今期は、ハイチへの軍派遣が中心となっており、待ち伏せ攻撃、エルサルバドル兵の死亡または行方不明の報道、そして焼けた車両に関する報道が含まれ、これらは否定的な影響を与えています。国内ニュースは日常的なもので、トルコおよびアラブ首長国連邦との租税協定の批准、ケンブリッジ大学による幼児教育分野の提携、観光に関する報道がそれを相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 아이티 군 파견이 주를 이루며, 매복 공격, 엘살바도르 군인의 사망 또는 실종 보도, 불탄 차량 관련 소식이 포함되어 부정적인 영향을 미칩니다. 국내 뉴스는 일상적인 수준이며, 튀르키예 및 아랍에미리트와의 조세 협정 비준, 케임브리지 대학과의 유아교육 협력, 관광 관련 보도가 이를 상쇄합니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्य रूप से हैती में सैन्य तैनाती छाई हुई है, जिसमें एक घात लगाकर हमला, अल सल्वाडोर के सैनिकों के मारे जाने या लापता होने की खबरें और एक जली हुई गाड़ी शामिल हैं, जो नकारात्मक रूप से प्रभावी है। घरेलू समाचार सामान्य हैं, जिनमें तुर्की और संयुक्त अरब अमीरात के साथ अनुमोदित कराधान समझौते, कैम्ब्रिज के साथ प्रारंभिक बाल्यावस्था साझेदारी और पर्यटन संबंधी समाचार इसकी भरपाई करते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από τη στρατιωτική αποστολή στην Αϊτή, συμπεριλαμβανομένης μιας ενέδρας, αναφορών για σκοτωμένους ή αγνοούμενους Σαλβαδορέους στρατιώτες και ενός καμένου οχήματος, γεγονός που επιδρά αρνητικά. Οι εγχώριες ειδήσεις είναι συνηθισμένες, με τις κυρωμένες συμφωνίες φορολογικής συνεργασίας με την Τουρκία και τα ΗΑΕ, τη σύμπραξη του Κέμπριτζ για την πρώιμη παιδική ηλικία και την κάλυψη του τουρισμού να την αντισταθμίζουν.
summary.tr: Dönem, Haiti'deki askeri konuşlanmaya hakim oluyor; bir pusu saldırısı, öldürüldüğü veya kayıp olduğu bildirilen Salvadorlu askerler ve yanmış bir araç bu konuda yer alıyor ve olumsuz bir ağırlık taşıyor. İç haberler rutin seyrediyor; Türkiye ve BAE ile onaylanan vergi anlaşmaları, bir Cambridge erken çocukluk eğitimi ortaklığı ve turizm haberleri bunu dengeliyor.
summary.es: El período está dominado por el despliegue militar en Haití, que incluye una emboscada, informes de soldados salvadoreños muertos o desaparecidos y un vehículo quemado, lo que pesa negativamente. Las noticias nacionales son rutinarias, y los acuerdos fiscales ratificados con Türkiye y los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, una alianza con Cambridge para la primera infancia y la cobertura turística la compensan.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par le déploiement militaire en Haïti, avec une embuscade, des informations faisant état de soldats salvadoriens tués ou disparus, et un véhicule incendié, ce qui pèse négativement. L'actualité intérieure est routinière, compensée par les accords fiscaux ratifiés avec la Türkiye et les Émirats arabes unis, un partenariat avec Cambridge pour la petite enfance et la couverture du tourisme.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird vom Militäreinsatz in Haiti bestimmt, darunter ein Hinterhalt, Berichte über getötete oder vermisste salvadorianische Soldaten und ein ausgebranntes Fahrzeug, was negativ ins Gewicht fällt. Die Inlandsnachrichten sind routinemäßig; ratifizierte Steuerabkommen mit der Türkei und den VAE, eine Partnerschaft mit Cambridge im frühkindlichen Bereich sowie Berichte über den Tourismus wirken dem entgegen.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pelo destacamento militar no Haiti, incluindo uma emboscada, relatos de soldados salvadorenhos mortos ou desaparecidos e um veículo queimado, o que pesa negativamente. As notícias internas são rotineiras, com acordos fiscais ratificados com a Türkiye e os Emirados Árabes Unidos, uma parceria com Cambridge para a primeira infância e a cobertura do turismo compensando esse quadro.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dal dispiegamento militare ad Haiti, compresa un'imboscata, notizie di soldati salvadoregni uccisi o dispersi e un veicolo incendiato, fattori che pesano negativamente. Le notizie interne sono di routine, con accordi fiscali ratificati con Türkiye e gli Emirati Arabi Uniti, una partnership con Cambridge per la prima infanzia e la copertura sul turismo che ne compensano l'effetto.
summary.ru: Период определяется военным развёртыванием на Гаити, включая засаду, сообщения о погибших или пропавших без вести сальвадорских солдатах и сожжённом автомобиле, что оказывает негативное влияние. Внутренние новости носят рутинный характер: ратифицированные соглашения об избежании двойного налогообложения с Турцией и ОАЭ, партнёрство с Кембриджем в области раннего детского развития и освещение туризма компенсируют этот эффект.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة عملية نشر عسكري في هايتي، تشمل كمينًا وتقارير عن مقتل جنود سلفادوريين أو فقدانهم، وحرق مركبة، وهو ما يُعد عاملًا سلبيًا. أما الأخبار المحلية فروتينية، إذ تُعادلها اتفاقيات ضريبية مصدّقة مع تركيا والإمارات العربية المتحدة، وشراكة مع جامعة كامبريدج في مجال الطفولة المبكرة، وتغطية لقطاع السياحة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر استقرار نظامی در هائیتی است، از جمله یک کمین، گزارش‌هایی درباره کشته یا مفقود شدن سربازان السالوادوری و سوزانده شدن یک خودرو که تأثیر منفی دارد. اخبار داخلی عادی است و توافق‌نامه‌های مالیاتی تصویب‌شده با ترکیه و امارات متحده عربی، همکاری با کمبریج در زمینه آموزش کودکی زودهنگام و پوشش گردشگری این اثر را تا حدی خنثی می‌کنند.
summary.zh: 此期间的主要新闻是军队赴海地部署，包括一起伏击事件、萨尔瓦多士兵伤亡或失踪的报道以及一辆车被烧毁，这些对整体形势产生负面影响。国内新闻较为常规，与土耳其和阿联酋批准的税收协定、剑桥大学的幼儿教育合作以及旅游报道形成一定抵消。

Τα οικονομικά νέα είναι μικτά: μια συρρίκνωση 5,8% που συνδέεται με τη μείωση της παραγωγής πετρελαίου αντισταθμίζεται από νέα συνεργασία στο φυσικό αέριο με το Καμερούν και από σύμβαση που συνδέεται με τη Chevron για την ανάπτυξη του κοιτάσματος φυσικού αερίου Aseng.
summary.tr: Dönemin büyük bölümüne, ulusal siyasetle ilgili olmayan spor kaynaklı bir olay hakim. Ekonomi haberleri karışık: petrol üretimindeki düşüşle bağlantılı %5,8'lik daralma, Kamerun ile yeni gaz iş birliği ve Aseng gaz projesi için Chevron bağlantılı bir sözleşmeyle dengeleniyor.
summary.es: El período está dominado en su mayor parte por un incidente deportivo que no es un asunto de asuntos nacionales. Las noticias económicas son mixtas: una contracción del 5,8 % vinculada a la caída de la producción petrolera se compensa con una nueva cooperación en gas con Camerún y un contrato vinculado a Chevron para el desarrollo del gas de Aseng.
summary.fr: La période est essentiellement dominée par un incident sportif qui ne relève pas des affaires nationales. Les nouvelles économiques sont contrastées : une contraction de 5,8 % liée à la baisse de la production pétrolière est compensée par une nouvelle coopération gazière avec le Cameroun et un contrat lié à Chevron pour le développement du gaz d'Aseng.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird überwiegend von einem Sportereignis bestimmt, das keine nationale politische Angelegenheit ist. Die Wirtschaftsnachrichten sind gemischt: Einem Rückgang der Wirtschaftsleistung um 5,8 %, der mit sinkender Ölförderung zusammenhängt, stehen eine neue Gaskooperation mit Kamerun und ein mit Chevron verbundener Auftrag für die Gasentwicklung Aseng gegenüber.
summary.pt: O período é dominado principalmente por um incidente esportivo que não é uma questão de assuntos nacionais. As notícias econômicas são mistas: uma contração de 5,8% ligada à queda da produção de petróleo é compensada por uma nova cooperação em gás com os Camarões e um contrato ligado à Chevron para o desenvolvimento do gás de Aseng.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato in gran parte da un episodio legato allo sport, che non riguarda gli affari nazionali. Le notizie economiche sono contrastanti: una contrazione del 5.8% legata al calo della produzione petrolifera è controbilanciata da una nuova cooperazione nel settore del gas con il Camerun e da un contratto legato a Chevron per lo sviluppo del gas di Aseng.
summary.ru: Период в основном определяется спортивным инцидентом, который не относится к государственным делам. Le poche storie pertinenti sono negative: il decesso di un detenuto in custodia e la segnalazione di una nave battente bandiera comoriana possibilmente affondata al largo della Romania, con un tono GDELT al di sotto della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Освещение скудное и в основном не относится к делу: здесь есть спам и материалы, посвящённые Майотте. Немногие релевантные сообщения носят негативный характер: смерть заключённого под стражей и сообщение о судне под флагом Коморских Островов, которое, возможно, затонуло у берегов Румынии; тон по GDELT ниже среднемирового уровня.
summary.ar: التغطية ضئيلة وغير ذات صلة في معظمها، وتتضمن رسائل مزعجة (spam) ومواد تركز على مايوت. القصص القليلة ذات الصلة سلبية: وفاة سجين محتجز، وتقرير عن سفينة ترفع علم جزر القمر ربما غرقت قبالة سواحل رومانيا، مع نبرة GDELT أدنى بكثير من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری اندک و عمدتاً نامرتبط است، با محتوای هرزنامه و مطالبی درباره مایوت. داستان‌های اندک مرتبط منفی‌اند: مرگ یک زندانی در بازداشت، و گزارشی از کشتی با پرچم کومور که احتمالاً در نزدیکی سواحل رومانی غرق شده است؛ لحن GDELT به‌طور قابل توجهی پایین‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 报道稀少且大多不相关，包括垃圾信息和聚焦马约特的内容。少数相关报道均为负面：一名在押人员死亡，以及一艘悬挂科摩罗旗的船只据报道可能在罗马尼亚近海沉没；GDELT语气远低于全球平均水平。
